In 1997–98, the [[Saudi First Division]], the second-tier league of [[Association football|football]] in Saudi Arabia, was won by [[Hajer Club|Hajer]] of the [[Hofuf|Al-Ahsa]] region. Along with [[Al-Ansar F.C.|Al-Ansar]] they were promoted to the [[Saudi Pro League]].
